summary: LPA, a NYSE American-listed Latin American industrial REIT, closed the previously disclosed sale of Parque Logístico Lima Sur in Peru to FIBRA Prime for US$145.0 million, after INDECOPI antitrust clearance and customary conditions. The price is a nearly 20% premium to prior carrying value, before the Q2 2026 fair value adjustment; book value per share was US$8.62 at June 30, 2026. LPA received US$85.0 million at closing, with US$60.0 million payable in two US$30.0 million installments at 12 and 24 months, accelerated via a US$55.0 million BTG Pactual facility at 8.50% fixed. Watch deferred-proceeds credit risk and Mexico redeployment timing.
